long_biography.plain_text:
Frustration with opaque yacht-charter processes led Philippe Bacou to create YOTHA in 2016. The platform was designed to connect owners, charter clients and professionals while moving negotiation, contracting and payment online. Bacou kept sales and concierge support around the technology, aiming to improve communication and transaction transparency.

Bacou also moved into yacht production as part of the Sea Finance consortium that acquired Cantieri di Pisa from a failed owner. He sold the historic builder to industrial group Alfagomma in 2021, making continued employment and production at the Pisa site conditions of the transaction. The decision marked his withdrawal from yacht manufacturing.
